description: Election Commission - M. A. C. Themal Jayaruksha Perera was Selected as the member of the Biyagama Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Biyagama Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
